design_goals: Use a multi-target astronomy analysis bundle instead of a code-repair prompt.
Keep with-skill and without-skill identical except for environment/skills.
Hide downstream acceptance logic behind a runtime-only observatory service.
Force real use of catalog, per-target manifests, quarantine masks, and live audit submission.
Make skill value come from a standardized vetting workflow, not a hidden answer file.

data_design.source_style: frozen TESS-like multi-sector photometry on realistic 2-minute cadence grids
targets: one planet candidate dominated by rotational variability
one planet candidate that is only recoverable after manifest quarantine windows are applied
data_design.determinism: all light curves, quality flags, manifests, and audit rules are frozen inside the single-container environment

main_tests: live audit accepts the produced bundle
all catalog targets are covered exactly once
manifest and audit endpoints were used through the real chain
per-target accounting and scientific fields are internally consistent
guardrails: placeholder reasons or empty bundle outputs fail
receipt hash must match the canonical final payload

readme_requirements: Document astronomy-physics template principles around multi-target vetting tasks.
Summarize oracle and with/without-skill E2B experiments only after clean runs complete.
Explain skill relevance in terms of lower diagnosis and convergence cost, especially for odd/even and secondary-eclipse checks.
